summary: ISS-2441 (PROP-053: --orphans-only flag hides tracker_only and mentioned_only buckets). Fixed build-scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js: --orphans-only now emits one-line summaries 'TRACKER-ONLY (no file, benign reservation drift): N' and 'MENTIONED-ONLY (cross-referenced, no standalone record): N' before returning. Verified: running --orphans-only now shows trailing summaries (51 tracker_only, 78 mentioned_only). Lost-deliverable signal is no longer silently hidden in routine integrity scans.
